hero.title: Design ya kitoko mpo na bakompanyi oyo elingi kozala makasi na miso ya bato.
hero.lead: Studio ya graphic design oyo esalaka ba imprimeries, emballage mpe ba systèmes ya marque ya makasi.

intro.title: Esalemi mpo na ba marques oyo esengeli komonana
intro.lead: Tosalaka elongo na ba entreprises ya kolonga na kolongono, magazini, masano mpe mombongo. Totikaka mosala pete, kitoko mpe ya kobima mbala moko.
intro.printDesc: Ba brochures, ba affiches, ba dépliants mpe ba étiquettes oyo ebongisami malamu mpo na kobimisa.
intro.digitalDesc: Bilili ya ba réseaux sociaux mpe ba publicités oyo ezalaka kitoko na ba écrans nionso.
intro.identityDesc: Logo, langi mpe mibeko ya marque mpo biloko nionso ezala na elongi moko.

services.title: Studio moko mpo na imprimerie, numérique mpe marque
services.lead: Briefing moko, équipe moko mpe monoko moko ya visual — kobanda na ebandeli tii na ba fichiers ya suka.
services.brochuresDesc: Ba catalogues ya biloko mpe ba profils ya compagnie oyo elimbolaka misala na bino.
services.postersDesc: Biloko ya feti mpe ya publicité oyo ebendaka likebi ya bato na balabala to na internet.
services.digitalDesc: Ba posts ya réseaux sociaux mpe ba bannières oyo ebongi na ba clients na bino.
services.labelsDesc: Ba étiquettes mpe bilamba ya biloko oyo emonanaka polele na ba magazini.

pillars.localDesc: Bilili oyo ebongi na zando na bino — masano, nkisi, magazini mpe mombongo.
pillars.deliveryDesc: Ba fichiers oyo ebongisami malamu mpe ya kobimisa na imprimerie.
pillars.controlDesc: Mibeko ya langi, mikanda mpe logo mpo mosala nionso ezala sembo.

ctaBand.title: Banda marque ya sika to bongisa oyo ozali na yango
ctaBand.lead: Branding elongo na biso elakisi logo, kopona langi, ba affiches mpe biloko nionso oyo esalaka compagnie ya solo.

simplify.title: Nzelá ya pete ya kosala elongo na studio na biso
simplify.lead: Mayele polele, banzela oyo ebongisami mpe ba fichiers ya koumela.
simplify.step1Desc: Yebisa biso eloko nini, bato nini mpe ntango nini esengeli kosila.
simplify.step2Desc: Kokanisa logo, langi mpe lolenge ya kotia biloko tii ekondimama.
simplify.step3Desc: Kotia yango na ba affiches, ba flyers, ba étiquettes mpe na ba réseaux.
simplify.step4Desc: Ba fichiers ya kobimisa na imprimerie mpe ya internet na ndakisa ya kosalela.

clients.title: Epesami motema na ba équipes oyo etekaka mikolo nionso
clients.lead: Kobanda na ba compagnies ya bokono tii na masano mpe mombongo ya mikili mingi.
clients.kelyDesc: Branding mpe imprimerie mpo na nkisi mpe kolongono.
clients.kottakkalDesc: Misala ya bilili mpo na kombo ya lokumu na lisano ya nkisi.
clients.welltechDesc: Bilili ya mombongo mpo na équipe ya mokili mobimba.
clients.petsOriginDesc: Emballage mpe publicité mpo na bilei ya banyama.
clients.oggyToyDesc: Bilili ya bopesi mpe esengo mpo na masano ya bana.
clients.newDelmonDesc: Design mpo na magazini mpe biloko ya sika ya koteka.
clients.alJazeeraDesc: Biembo, ba étiquettes mpe biloko ya mombongo mpo na bapanzi biloko ya kolia.

news.studioTitle: Branding mobimba, kaka te fichier ya logo
news.studioDesc: Logo, langi, ba affiches mpe système mobimba mpo na kotia makambo malamu.
news.campaignTitle: Kobanda na affiche moko tii na campagne mobimba
news.campaignDesc: Ba brochures, ba flyers, ba étiquettes mpe bilili oyo ezali na lolenge moko.

contact.title: Yebisa biso eloko nini olingi tosalela yo
contact.lead: Brochure, affiche, flyer, elili ya numérique, étiquette, logo to branding mobimba. Tinda mokanda mpe tokoyanola mbala moko.
contact.point1: Ba fichiers ya kobimisa na imprimerie mpe internet
contact.point2: Système ya logo mpe kopona langi
contact.point3: Ba affiches, flyers, étiquettes mpe campagnes
contact.messagePlaceholder: Yebisa biso mpo na marque na yo, mosala oyo olingi mpe ntango.
contact.statusSuccess: Email na yo ezali kofungwama mpo na kotinda mokanda.

footer.tagline: Design graphique mpo na imprimerie, numérique mpe marque.
